description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Just Beachin”, your effortless coastal getaway in the heart of Prominence on 30A. Perfectly positioned just steps from The Big Chill, this stylish townhouse offers the ideal blend of convenience, comfort and fun for families and groups. Spend your days cruising to the beach in the 6-seater LSV, relaxing by the resort-style pools or exploring scenic 30A with 4 included bikes. With inviting living spaces, a thoughtfully designed layout and everything you need just moments away, “Just Beachin” makes it easy to settle in, unwind and enjoy the best of 30A living. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Prominence 30A location just steps from The Big Chill with dining, shopping and entertainmentSleeps 10 with 3 bedrooms and 2.5 baths, perfect for families and groups6-seater LSV included for easy beach access and exploring 30AAccess to 2 resort-style community pools4 bikes included for scenic rides along 30AOpen-concept living with spacious kitchen and comfortable gathering areasPrivate back patio with ample seating for relaxing outdoorsTwo garage parking spaces for added convenience*** LIVING AREAS ***The living space is warm, inviting and designed for easy coastal living. Whether you’re returning from a beach day or settling in for a movie night, the comfortable seating and open layout create a relaxed atmosphere where everyone can gather and unwind.Cozy living area with ample seating and flat-screen TVOpen-concept design connecting living, dining and kitchen spacesEasy access to the back patio for indoor-outdoor living*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The spacious kitchen is both functional and inviting, offering everything you need to prepare meals while staying connected with family and friends. From quick breakfasts before the beach to relaxed dinners at home, this space makes gathering effortless.Stainless steel appliances and generous counter spaceBar seating for 4 perfect for casual meals and conversationDining area with seating for 5*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Enjoy laid-back outdoor living on the private back patio, perfect for unwinding after a day along 30A. Whether you're sipping morning coffee or relaxing in the evening breeze, this outdoor space offers a quiet place to recharge.Spacious back patio with ample seatingIdeal for morning coffee, evening drinks and relaxed downtime*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With a thoughtfully designed layout across two levels, “Just Beachin” comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests while offering a balance of privacy and shared space.1st FloorPowder room conveniently located off the kitchen2nd FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed and flat-screen TVShared Guest Bathroom: Single vanity and shower/tub combo, conveniently located between the queen suite and bunk roomBunk Room: Two triple-stack twin bunk beds sleeping 6 and flat-screen TV*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in Prominence North along 30A, “Just Beachin” places you in one of the most vibrant and convenient communities along the coast. With resort-style amenities and walkable access to dining and entertainment, everything you need is right at your fingertips.The Big Chill: Steps away with live music, movies, dining, shopping and family-friendly activitiesTwo resort-style community pools including a zero-entry poolPoolside grilling stations for easy cookoutsDeer Lake State Park: Just a short LSV ride for beach access and nature trailsEasy access to Seaside, Seagrove and Rosemary Beach for shopping, dining and coastal exploring*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to access the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesWaiver required to access the 6-seater LSV.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
